import ctypes
L=27
rdx=(L*0xF4243) & ((1<<64)-1)
rdx=(rdx+7)&((1<<64)-1)
rdx=(rdx*rdx)&((1<<64)-1)
rdx=(rdx+0xE)&((1<<64)-1)
rdx=(rdx*0xEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEF)&((1<<64)-1)
rdx=(rdx+0x2222222222222222)&((1<<64)-1)
rax=0x1111111111111110
print(hex(rdx), rdx)
print('cmp rax>=rdx?', rax>=rdx)

table = bytes.fromhex('9d6d2ce98e1db830dd79e88b25e67f0d903ca95df85d57a1f8374a')
assert len(table)==27
edx = (0xffffffff - 36) # -37 in unsigned 32
out=[]
for i,b in enumerate(table):
    inp = b ^ (edx & 0xff)
    out.append(inp)
    edx = (edx + inp) & 0xffffffff
print('out bytes:', bytes(out))
print('as latin1:', bytes(out).decode('latin1'))
# check if printable
import string
print('printable ratio', sum(32<=c<127 for c in out)/len(out))
print('hex', bytes(out).hex())
